title: What Is a Semiconductor FSE? Field Service Engineer Duties and How They Differ from Equipment Engineers
excerpt: A semiconductor FSE (field service engineer) works for the equipment maker and supports the installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of manufacturing equipment at customer fabs. This beginner's guide explains how FSEs differ from equipment engineers, the words you see in job postings, and the experience that helps people new to semiconductors get closer to this job.
